topic.title: Deliverables
topic.shortdesc: Deliverables define the published output that authors build from a publication, such as WebHelp or PDF.

body.p: Authors use deliverables to generate output from project content. A deliverable is based on a publication and defines how the output is built.

Deliverables support common publishing workflows such as building WebHelp or PDF output. Depending on the setup, authors can also download the output, inspect logs, schedule builds, or deploy the result through a publishing connector.

ul.li: The output type, such as WebHelp or PDF.
The publication used as the content source.

section.title: Why Deliverables Matter
section.p: Deliverables turn source content into usable output for readers. They are the final step in the authoring and publishing workflow.
